name: Midori Caret
description: Draws the editor caret, the editor selection band, the note-title caret and the note-title selection band as real elements so the Midori theme can size them. Needed because the Midori fonts carry symmetric ascent/descent overrides, which makes everything the browser derives from font metrics centre on the baseline instead of on the ink. The two selection bands are desktop-only: iOS ignores ::selection on an editable, so a drawn band there would sit under an unremovable native one.
author: Benjamin Loschen
